CustomField.description: Marks a carrier as unavailable when any individual cart item weighs 140 lbs or more and the delivery method is Collect or 3rd Party Bill To Address (CRM-4423).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: If checked, this carrier is disabled in checkout for individual items over 140 lbs under Collect / 3rd Party Bill To Address.
